historical_spend_validation.summary: Planning budget B ($148,911.68) validated against historical advertising expenditure of $175,190.21 (85.0% of historical spend; Slide 5 Step 4).

q4.headline: Total budget  Σ C·X ≤ B has the highest shadow price: +1 $ of its limit adds 2.086261 conversions to the plan.

robustness.summary: Dual values / shadow prices verified via two-sided finite-difference re-solves. The marginal rates are stable under local parameter perturbation (Slide 19).

q4.note: Dual values come from the PuLP/CBC LP solution. Each is re-checked by re-solving with the limit moved one step up and one step down: $1,000 for budgets, 0.5% of the limit (at least one unit) for capacity and minimum rows. A price is verified when it lies between the two one-sided slopes.
